title: Camp Spot Arrival After Dark Risk
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ioverlander:place arrival_hour=* place_name=*
| eval after_dark=if(arrival_hour>=20 OR arrival_hour<6,1,0)
| stats sum(after_dark) as dark_arrivals, count as stays by place_name
| eval dark_arrival_pct=round(100*dark_arrivals/stays,1)
| sort - dark_arrival_pct
description: Shows which kinds of camp stops are most often reached after dark, when setup and situational awareness are harder.
value: Late arrivals add stress, reduce camp quality, and can hide site or safety issues until it is too late to adjust.
implementation: Add an `arrival_hour` field when logging each stop and review the after-dark percentage by place or trip type.
visualization: Table of camp spots by after-dark arrival percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which camp stops you keep reaching too late to set up comfortably.
